name: EnvironmentalSiteComplianceLog
tagline: Dust, noise, vibration and water monitoring against consent limits – with exceedance notifications, corrective actions and a compliance report.
description: A complete construction environmental monitoring app for Power Apps and Power Pages: log readings at every monitoring point, see trigger and limit exceedances instantly, meet the regulator notification deadline, drive investigations and corrective actions to close-out, spot repeat exceedances, monitoring gaps and out-of-hours noise, and produce the monthly compliance summary.
features: Trigger and limit bands incl. lower limits (pH)
Notification deadline with countdown and overdue alerts
Investigation → corrective action → verified close-out workflow
Permitted working hours for noise and vibration
Monitor trend charts with trigger and limit lines
Compliance report text and CSV export
Bulk review / investigate / void with undo
Demo mode with realistic fictional data
